_comment: Drives eddy.test (probe_eddy_current / LDC1612) under the simavr bridge. 0x7e/0x7f are the manufacturer/device id the driver verifies at startup (TI 0x5449 / LDC1612 0x3055). The DATA0 (0x00/0x01) count and STATUS (0x18) are served by the bridge's ldc1612_ramp: a 28-bit count = baseline_raw + free_per_step * net_descent (net_descent = absolute Z stepper position; dir level 0 = descending on this cfg's [stepper_z] PL3/PL1, verified from the KLIPPY_LDC1612_RAMP_TRACE step trace). Geometry is derived from the cfg's calibration table and the current probe-helper descent: with freq_conv = 24MHz/2^28 = 0.089407 Hz/raw, the descend trigger height_to_freq(descend_z=0.4) = 2.875 MHz = raw 32156330. baseline_raw 31556000 (2.821 MHz, z~0.83 on the curve) sits below the trigger so the 'gt' trigger is not already satisfied at arm; free_per_step 500 crosses the trigger ~1200 steps (3 mm) into a descend probe, and keeps every settled read between the bridge floor (0x1CEA000 = 2.711 MHz, just above the calibration's furthest point 2.7 MHz @ z=5) and the curve top for all test heights up to z~9.5 - so G28, BED_MESH_CALIBRATE (default/scan/rapid_scan) and PROBE all cross the threshold with real signal dynamics instead of a pegged count. contact_descent/depress_per_step give the count a piecewise knee ~0.5 mm above the descend stop for the tap detector's slope-change. emulator_skip_gcode: PROBE METHOD=tap and PROBE_EDDY_CURRENT_TAP_CALIBRATE run only in fileoutput (matching the framework's historically validated scope): under the emulator, sustained sampling+motion load on the 250 kbaud AVR link degrades the clocksync frequency estimate (observed 16.00->15.65 MHz with 'Ignoring clock sample' storms during the scan phase), which warps the sample-time-to-stepper-position correlation the tap's pullback least-squares fit depends on; re-gating tap needs that clock-sync interaction fixed first (or an ARM-MCU eddy test). intb_pin (PK7) is held low so query_status_ldc1612 reports data-ready; auto_trsync_trigger_ticks fires the X/Y cartesian endstops on G28. tick_mode runs the bridge in tick-socket lockstep so the climb and trigger are deterministic regardless of host load. config_overrides pins the LDC1612 to the pre-d2aa4bd7e 250 SPS default on the emulator's materialized cfg copy only (the shared eddy.cfg stays byte-identical to upstream): simavr's atmega2560 at 250 kbaud cannot sustain the 400 SPS bulk_sensor frame load - one bulk sample drops on a busy probe descent and the eddy gather's _validate_samples_time trips 'Eddy: Gaps in the data: 0.004 > 0.003'. The ldc1612_ramp sample_rate knob below must match it so the bridge paces DATA0 at the rate klippy expects.
